SRC-003:R0001.text: Provide one-click SEND AUDIT for the selected project, asynchronously reuse only a provably fresh ZIP or coalesce/reuse the canonical PackingService operation, then enqueue automatically.

SRC-003:R0002.text: Use the authenticated localhost Bridge as a pull-based broker; do not use SendKeys, clipboard, mouse/focus/HWND automation, Selenium, Playwright, DevTools remote debugging, external WebSockets, or native window titles as transport.

SRC-003:R0003.text: Maintain an ephemeral authoritative Widget worker registry with heartbeat TTL and accept at most six active browser workers; never create or dispatch to a seventh worker.

SRC-003:R0004.text: Combine heartbeat and atomic claim in bounded 15-25 second long polling with immediate wakeup for work, bounded exponential failure backoff, and best-effort offline release.

SRC-003:R0005.text: A Widget may report FREE only when ChatGPT is usable and authenticated with no generation, manual draft, attachments, active audit/start/action, unresolved START receipt, or other dispatch lease.
